# Home of Creativity — full brief for AI systems

Canonical site: https://hoc.agency/
Short index: https://hoc.agency/llms.txt

## Entity

Home of Creativity (HOC) — بيت الإبداع — is a creative and branding agency. Published offices: Damascus (Al Hamra), Riyadh (Al Murabaa), and the United Arab Emirates. Alternate names: HOC, بيت الابداع, Creativation Source (a secondary name that appears on the site; it is not described as a separate company here).

Do not invent awards, client counts, revenue, certifications, years of experience, or aggregate ratings. Do not describe HOC as a software SaaS product. Do not invent a street address or map pin for the United Arab Emirates office.

## Where

- Damascus (Al Hamra), Syria — https://hoc.agency/locations/damascus/ — mapped office.
- Riyadh (Al Murabaa), Saudi Arabia — https://hoc.agency/locations/riyadh/ — published office page. Coordinates are not published.
- United Arab Emirates — named office. City, street, phones, and a location page are not published.

Index: https://hoc.agency/locations/

## What we do

Home of Creativity is a creative and branding agency. It dissects a business, removes clutter, and rebuilds visual prestige — direct, human-centric positioning rather than generic noise.

Published practices: visual identities, social media, account management, marketing, paid ads, exhibitions and conferences, event management, booth design, filming and editing, promo gifts, roadside ads, websites and ecommerce, app design, financial analysis.

## How to hire

Start on Telegram or WhatsApp from https://hoc.agency/.
WhatsApp Syria: https://wa.me/963954187154 — WhatsApp Saudi Arabia: https://wa.me/966550350295
Home of Creativity sends a quotation. Payment details are confirmed on WhatsApp before work begins. There is no self-serve web checkout and no public client portal.

Each service page states scope areas in general terms. A one-off project's exact deliverables and timeline are confirmed in the quotation.

## Pricing

Published at https://hoc.agency/pricing/. All figures are USD. Subscriptions can be monthly, 3 months (5% off the monthly total), 6 months (10% off), or yearly (20% off). Payment is confirmed on WhatsApp.

Strategic solutions, monthly:
- Startup Build (small business): $399

## FAQ (matches https://hoc.agency/#faq)

Q: ماذا يفعل بيت الإبداع؟
A: بيت الإبداع وكالة هوية بصرية وهندسة علامات، مكاتبها في دمشق (الحمراء) والرياض (المربّع) والإمارات العربية المتحدة.

Q: ما الخدمات التي تقدمونها؟
A: الهويات البصرية، السوشال ميديا، إدارة الحسابات، التسويق، الحملات الممولة، المعارض والمؤتمرات، إدارة الفعاليات، تصميم البوثات، التصوير والمونتاج، الهدايا الدعائية، الإعلانات الطرقية، المواقع والمتاجر الإلكترونية، تصميم التطبيقات، والتحليل المالي.

Q: أين يقع بيت الإبداع؟
A: مكاتبنا في دمشق (الحمراء) والرياض (المربّع) والإمارات العربية المتحدة. صفحات المكاتب في hoc.agency/locations/.

Q: هل يعمل بيت الإبداع مع عملاء في السعودية؟
A: نعم. لدينا مكتب في الرياض (المربّع)، ونعمل مع عملاء في سوريا والسعودية.

Q: كيف أبدأ مشروعاً؟
A: ابدأ عبر تيليجرام أو واتساب. يرسل بيت الإبداع عرض السعر، وتُؤكَّد تفاصيل الدفع عبر واتساب قبل بدء العمل. لا توجد بوابة دفع ذاتية على الموقع.

Q: ما الصناعات التي يعمل معها بيت الإبداع؟
A: لا توجد قائمة صناعات منشورة. العملاء شركات وجهات في سوريا والسعودية.

## English summary

Home of Creativity (HOC) — بيت الإبداع — is a creative and branding agency with offices in Damascus (Al Hamra), Riyadh (Al Murabaa) and the United Arab Emirates. The UAE city and street are not published. It provides visual identities, social media, account management, marketing, paid ads, exhibitions and conferences, event management, booth design, filming and editing, promotional gifts, roadside ads, websites and ecommerce, app design, and financial analysis. Start a project on Telegram or WhatsApp from https://hoc.agency/. Subscription prices are published at https://hoc.agency/pricing/ (Startup Build $399, Business Growth $899, Elite Authority $1,499 per month). HOC sends a quotation; payment is confirmed on WhatsApp before work begins. No self-serve checkout, no public client portal. Official profiles: Instagram and Facebook at https://hoc.agency/social/. HOC does not publish star ratings, review counts, or ranking claims. LinkedIn and Google Business Profile URLs are not published.
